points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight outputs structurally validate, but Re20 is labeled converged despite drifting forces and run_status reduction orders are written with negative sign in main.cpp:277–278.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original explicit validator passes eight packages and report; this is structural only and does not prove vortex shedding, force stability or report reproducibility.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re20 plateau drifts materially and Re200 explicitly converges to a steady non-shedding wake, although both are marked completed/converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.15 laminar Cl≈0.592 and Re20 Cl≈−1.21 are highly asymmetric; Re200 force is nearly constant. M0.8/M2 inviscid are more credible.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 17-page PDF supplies actual case histories and fields; several laminar force plots and Re200 late drag are flattened by startup and cannot demonstrate late behavior.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report honestly discloses first-order modes, spurious lift and no Re200 shedding, but calls Re20 plateau stable despite material force drift.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF SHA and immutable TeX match, original force histories corroborate key values; excluded figure assets limit report rebuilding and original signed-order metadata needs interpretation.
